config._note: recruiting-ats-basic (2026-07-13): candidate PII (candidateName/email/phone/cvFile/motivation) lives DIRECTLY on this Application -- there is deliberately no separate Candidate entity (AVG data-minimisation, design D2): one object = one retention clock = one delete. The 'Application' widget excludes vacancyId (Related resolves the Vacancy) and the three privacy fields (talentPoolOptIn/rejectedDate/retentionExpiryDate), which instead surface on the dedicated 'Privacy & retention' widget so the AVG retention clock is never buried among ordinary fields. lifecycleActions expose exactly screenen/uitnodigen/aanbieden/aannemen/afwijzen (design D3) -- no invented edges; aannemen's onboarding hand-off (creating the Employee from this data) is a MANUAL follow-up action in the MVP, no cross-object write hook fires here. Audit history is a sidebar tab. offer-esign (2026-07-16): page-level action "request-offer-signature" mirrors PayslipDetail's "Genereer PDF" shape -- POST /api/offer/request-signature with {applicationId: @objectId}, guarded server-side by OfferController::authorizeApplication() (resolve-first RBAC) + isAdminOrHr() + the aanbod-stage guard. The 'Application' data widget's exclude list additionally hides offerLetterFileId/offerSigningRequestId (internal correlation ids) -- offerSigningStatus stays visible as the human-readable state.

params.title: Vacancies
params.description: Vacancies (recruiting-ats-basic): draft -> published -> closed publish lifecycle. No external multiposting (werk.nl/LinkedIn) and no public vacancy page in the MVP.

params.title: Vacancy
params.note: recruiting-ats-basic (2026-07-13): the 'Vacancy' widget carries every field (title/description/department/status/publishedDate/closingDate). The 'Sollicitaties' related widget resolves the incoming Application.vacancyId references -- the candidate list per vacancy. lifecycleActions expose exactly publiceren/sluiten (design D3) -- no re-open and no publish-from-closed edge; a closed vacancy is re-created, not resurrected. Audit history is a sidebar tab.

params.title: Applications
params.description: Application pipeline (recruiting-ats-basic): new -> screening -> interview -> offer -> hired/rejected. The status filter is the MVP pipeline surface -- every stage is a filter value; a kanban board is an nc-vue widget follow-up (design D7).

params.title: Interviews
params.description: interview-scheduling: scheduled, completed and cancelled job interviews. An interview is synced to the shared calendar through the InterviewDetail page or 'occ hrmq:interview:sync' (design D1/D6).

params.title: Interview
params.note: interview-scheduling (2026-07-16): one interview round (gesprek) for an Application -- a SEPARATE schema, not fields on Application, because one Application can have multiple interview rounds each with its own lifecycle/calendarEventUid (design.md D2). The 'Interview' data widget excludes applicationId (Related resolves the Application) and calendarEventUid stays visible as the system-managed idempotency marker (design.md D3) -- an inspectable 'has this ever reached the calendar' signal, never user-editable. lifecycleActions expose exactly voltooien/annuleren (design D2) -- no invented edges; rescheduling is a plain field update to scheduledStart/scheduledEnd, not a status transition. The page-level 'Sync naar agenda' api-call action mirrors ApplicationDetail's 'request-offer-signature' shape -- POST /api/interviews/sync with {interviewId: @objectId}, guarded server-side by InterviewController::authorizeInterview() (resolve-first RBAC) + isAdminOrHr(). No files widget -- the schema carries no document/retention field. Audit history is a sidebar tab.

headerActions.successMessage: Interview synced to the shared calendar.
